title: Padding clauses to three literals
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, and let a term on $n$ variables have pairwise distinct literal indices. The construction gives a list of terms on $n+3$ variables: for a term with no literals, it gives the eight triples of padding literals with all sign choices; for one literal, it gives the four triples formed from its lifted literal and every sign choice on two padding variables; for two literals, it gives the two triples formed from their lifted literals and either sign of one padding literal; for three literals, it gives the single triple of their lifted literals. For terms of every other length, it gives the empty list.
hypotheses_covered: A term on $n$ variables whose literal indices are pairwise distinct
